intro: Whispering Horror Residue is the squirming remnant of a strange beast recovered from beneath the Whispering Forest. Gathered by intrepid adventurers, these void-touched remains are brought to Father Lankester in Undercity's War Quarter for shadow research.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have something for me, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.
I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, adventurer. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
